name: Muhafiz
overview:
Muhafiz tells the story of two strong individuals from different worlds whose lives are changed when fate brings them together. It is a journey defined by protection, emotional conflict, and inner struggle.

Their lives unexpectedly collide when Zawar saves Paras from a life-threatening situation, an act that leaves Behzad deeply impressed. To ensure her safety, Behzad assigns Zawar as her bodyguard. Zawar initially refuses, but fate compels him to accept the responsibility.

What follows is a journey of resistance, emotional distance, and unspoken tension as Paras strongly rejects Zawar’s presence in her life. However, forced proximity slowly begins to reshape their world in ways neither of them anticipated.

Will Zawar remain just Paras’s bodyguard, or become something more?Will Zawar be able to balance duty and emotions?Will fate bring Zawar and Paras closer together?
